summary: Startupbootcamp Georgia is accepting applications to Dare to Start through November 27, 2026. The hybrid founder-market-fit program runs January 12–March 2, 2027 and requires a company registered in Georgia before joining.

proposed_event.name: Startupbootcamp Georgia — Dare to Start 2027
proposed_event.description: Two-month hybrid founder-market-fit program for approximately 40 founders. Sector-agnostic and tech-enabled; Georgian company registration required before joining.

dates.date_range_text: Apply by November 27, 2026. Program January 12–March 2, 2027. Applicants hear back in the week of December 7.

sources.title: Dare to Start
sources.supports: Confirms 2027 dates, application deadline, hybrid format and Georgian registration eligibility.

notes: GEL 50K/150K grants advertised for later MVP/Market Entry stages must not be attributed to Dare to Start.
